verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents a broad REST API for accessing and changing account configuration, including users, notification rules, incident workflows, on-call, and incident creation. A public OpenAPI schema, an interactive reference for every public API, a SCIM API and an MCP server round this out. However, no evidence states that the API matches the UI feature for feature, and newer UI surfaces have no documented API coverage. missing for 10: an explicit statement of UI/API parity, documented API coverage for UI features such as Post-Incident Reviews, Status Pages, AI agents and On-Call Readiness Reports, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The REST API provides a way for third parties to connect to a PagerDuty account and access or manipulate configuration data on that account.
add and configure users on a PagerDuty account, including how they're notified by PagerDuty - set up workflows for responding to incidents - find out who is on call and when they're being notified
Browse every PagerDuty public API — endpoints, schemas, and code samples — and try requests directly from the docs.
This repository contains our OpenAPI defined public APIs.
